summary: Dirge Quikcleave keeps his word, and you carry his five-hundred-pound chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops came before this delivery.

sections.title: A Bargain Kept
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave hands over the chicken he promised. A goblin keeps his word, he says. He cannot guess why a gnome wants a bird that size, and grumbles that it must be for sleeping in. From there, you carry the chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

sections.title: Narain's Welcome
sections.body: Narain Soothfancy catches the scent of Dirge's chicken. He drives both fists into the bird, then stuffs his face with Dirge's cooking. It is the best chicken he has ever tasted, Narain says.

aliases: what did i do before this
faq.answer: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops came first. Dirge Quikcleave asked for rocket fuel and salt to finish his recipe.

aliases: who do i take this to
faq.answer: Narain Soothfancy receives the massive chicken in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why did Dirge prepare a five-hundred-pound chicken?
faq.answer: Dirge prepared the five-hundred-pound chicken to keep his word and hand it over. He says he cannot imagine what a gnome wants with a bird that size.

faq.q: What comes after delivering the chicken?
faq.answer: The Good News and The Bad News follows. Narain offers it only after Narain's Scrying Goggles and Draconic For Dummies: Volume II are finished.
